title: cyclosorus subpubescens
intro: Cyclosorus subpubescens, commonly known as the 'Rough Shield Fern', is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a plant with potential health benefits, as it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus subpubescens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
